name: Gather Rot Blossoms
summary: In Duskwood, Tavernkeep Smitts needs rot blossoms for his zombie juice. They grow inside the skulls of skeletal horrors and fiends in the graveyards.

sections.title: A Bizarre Ingredient
sections.body: At the Scarlet Raven Tavern, Tavernkeep Smitts sometimes brews a strange drink. His zombie juice calls for rot blossoms, which root inside the empty skulls of animated skeletons. Smitts avoids the undead, so passing mercenaries gather the blossoms for him.

sections.title: Graveyard Pest Control
sections.body: Rot blossoms grow on skeletal horrors and fiends in the overgrown plots of Tranquil Gardens Cemetery and Raven Hill Cemetery. The Night Watch militia is stretched thin against the terrors creeping through the woods. Smitts commends those who hunt the dead to Commander Althea Ebonlocke, helping thin the restless ranks that threaten Darkshire.

aliases: where do rot blossoms come from
faq.answer: Rot blossoms are foul plants that grow amid dark magic and decay. In Duskwood, they sprout inside the skulls of animated skeletal horrors and fiends.

faq.q: Why does Tavernkeep Smitts need rot blossoms?
faq.answer: Tavernkeep Smitts uses rot blossoms to brew zombie juice, a drink requested by certain patrons in the region.

faq.q: Where can the skeletons bearing these blossoms be found?
faq.answer: Skeletal horrors and fiends bearing rot blossoms haunt Duskwood’s burial grounds. They are found especially at Tranquil Gardens Cemetery near Darkshire and Raven Hill Cemetery to the west.

faq.q: Does this task help the defense of Darkshire?
faq.answer: Yes. Darkshire relies on the Night Watch against constant undead attacks. Hunting skeletons for their blossoms thins the monsters threatening the town and helps Commander Althea Ebonlocke.

faq.q: What comes next after delivering the blossoms?
faq.answer: After Smitts receives the blossoms and brews the zombie juice, he asks you to deliver the draught to Abercrombie, an eccentric hermit near Raven Hill Cemetery.

faq.q: Is zombie juice a normal beverage served in Darkshire?
faq.answer: No. The Scarlet Raven Tavern usually serves regional fare. Smitts prepares zombie juice, a strange brew with necrotic ingredients, only when he receives an eccentric order.

angles.text: Rot blossoms are dark growths rooted in necromantic decay and animated bone. Ordinary herbs flourish in rich soil and sunlight.
As an Alliance adventurer, you ease the Night Watch’s daily fight by hunting undead in Duskwood’s cemeteries and helping keep Darkshire from falling.
